description: Ministry of City Planning & Water Supply -  Order to acquire the lands in Bodhi katuwa, Ratthota D/S Division, Matale District ; Thihagoda D/S Division Matara District ; Pathadumbara D/S Division, Kandy District for Water Supply Projects
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition for a water supply project, including detailed descriptions of specific land parcels, their boundaries, and claimants. While it mentions a minister's name and title, the core content focuses on land matters (acquisition of immovable property and servitude rights for infrastructure projects) rather than government personnel changes or detailed portfolio responsibilities. The extensive land descriptions and property details place it firmly in the Land Gazettes category.
